scope: Decoded plain GLBs, names, socket frames, conservative station separation, door aperture rays and sampled kinematic docking. No force, pressure or general collision simulation.
checks: All three plain GLBs validate with zero errors and warnings; finite, nondegenerate geometry
Unique dot-free names, same hierarchy/TRS and sockets across tiers; envelope difference below 1 mm
Game triangle target and all distance targets met; 11 articulated draws reported
Outer doors close the aperture and clear it when open; collar extension interlock holds
Two animated tiers sampled through all 72 seconds: opposing mating normals, latch-before-open and close-before-release
Non-coupling meshes remain outside station bounding plane through entire cycle; contact geometry is excluded
Distance adapter preserves every local transform; original station exports remain byte-identical
